(4-20 pts)\n - [ ] Range > 4 pts? YES\n - [ ] Range < 20 pts? YES\n - [ ] **ORB VALID: YES**\n\nIf ORB is choppy (< 4 pts) or too wide (> 20 pts) \u2192 **SKIP THIS TRADE**\n\n---\n\n### SECTION B: FILTER STACK CHECK (09:30+ ET)\n\n**Check each filter. Circle YES or NO:**\n\n**Filter 1: VWAP Alignment**\n- Is price ABOVE VWAP? \u2192 [ ] YES [ ] NO\n- (For LONG, price must be above VWAP)\n- Result: _______________\n\n**Filter 2: EMA Alignment**\n- Is EMA 20 above EMA 50? \u2192 [ ] YES [ ] NO\n- Is EMA 50 above EMA 200? \u2192 [ ] YES [ ] NO\n- (Both must be TRUE for uptrend)\n- Result: _______________\n\n**Filter 3: Volume Confirmation**\n- Is current volume > 1.5x average? \u2192 [ ] YES [ ] NO\n- (Strong volume = institutional participation)\n- Result: _______________\n\n**Filter 4: Displacement Candle**\n- Is candle body > 2x average body size? \u2192 [ ] YES [ ] NO\n- (Strong move = momentum confirmation)\n- Result: _______________\n\n**CONFLUENCE SCORE:**\n- [ ] 4+ filters aligned = STRONG ENTRY (HIGH PROBABILITY)\n- [ ] 3 filters aligned = GOOD ENTRY (STANDARD)\n- [ ] 2 filters aligned = WEAK ENTRY (SKIP)\n- [ ] 1 filter aligned = NO ENTRY (SKIP)\n\n**Minimum filters to enter: 3**\n\n---\n\n### SECTION C: PRICE ACTION CONFIRMATION (09:30+ ET)\n\n**Scenario 1: Breakout + Retest (Primary)**\n\n- [ ] Did price close ABOVE ORB_HIGH?\n- [ ] Did price pull back INTO the ORB range after breakout?\n- [ ] Is this a candle closing ABOVE the retest high?\n- [ ] Can I see strong candle body (not just wick)?\n- All 4 = YES? \u2192 **ENTER ON CLOSE**\n\n**Scenario 2: Liquidity Sweep (Alternative)**\n\n- [ ] Did price sweep BELOW a key support level?\n- [ ] Did a rejection candle form (closed above sweep)?\n- [ ] Is volume high on the rejection candle?\n- [ ] Can I see the structure change (higher high after sweep)?\n- All 4 = YES? \u2192 **ENTER ON CLOSE**\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\ude80 FINAL ENTRY DECISION\n\n**ALL THREE SECTIONS MUST BE YES:**\n\n| Section | Status | \u2713 |\n|---------|--------|---|\n| A: ORB Valid? | YES / NO | \u2713 |\n| B: Filters 3+? | YES / NO | \u2713 |\n| C: PA Ready? | YES / NO | \u2713 |\n\n**If all 3 YES \u2192 ENTER** \n**If any NO \u2192 WAIT or SKIP**\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udcb0 POSITION SETUP\n\n**Entry Price**: _______________\n\n**Stop Loss**: ORB_LOW = _______________ \n**Risk**: Entry - SL = _____ pts\n\n**Target 1 (1R)**: Entry + (SL distance \u00d7 1) = _______________ \n**Target 2 (2R)**: Entry + (SL distance \u00d7 2) = _______________ \n**Target 3 (3R)**: Entry + (SL distance \u00d7 3) = _______________\n\n**Position Size**: 1 MES contract \n**Risk Amount**: $100-200\n\n---\n\n## \u23f0 TIME RULES\n\n- \u2713 Earliest entry: **09:30 ET** (market open)\n- \u2713 Latest entry: **10:30 ET** (don't chase late)\n- \u2713 Forced close: **11:00 ET** (no overnight)\n- \u2713 No entries after 10:30 ET\n\n---\n\n## \u2705 EXIT RULES\n\n**Profit Taking (Scale Out):**\n- [ ] 25% position: Exit at Target 1 (1R)\n- [ ] 25% position: Exit at Target 2 (2R)\n- [ ] 25% position: Exit at Target 3 (3R)\n- [ ] 25% position: Trailing stop or structure level\n\n**Stop Loss:**\n- [ ] Hit SL? Exit immediately\n- [ ] Max loss: $100-200 per trade\n\n**Time-Based:**\n- [ ] 11:00 ET? Close all positions\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udcca POST-TRADE REVIEW\n\n**After every trade, record:**\n\n- Entry time: _____________\n- Entry price: _____________\n- Entry reason (which filters aligned?): _____________\n- Exit time: _____________\n- Exit price: _____________\n- Exit reason: _____________\n- P&L: _____ pts = $_____ USD\n- Lesson learned: _____________\n\n---\n\n## \ud83c\udfaf EXPECTED RESULTS (Per Research)\n\n**If you follow this checklist:**\n- Win Rate: 30-35%\n- Profit Factor: 1.5-1.8\n- Average Trade: +$65-80\n- Max Drawdown: 20-25%\n\n**Red Flags if results are different:**\n- Win rate < 25%? \u2192 You're entering too early or with weak filters\n- Profit Factor < 1.3? \u2192 Your stops are too wide or targets too tight\n- Drawdown > 30%? \u2192 You're not following SL or time stops\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udca1 REMEMBER\n\n**This checklist is your decision framework.**\n\nDon't override it based on \"feeling.\" Don't chase entries after 10:30 ET. Don't hold overnight. Don't risk more than $100-200 per trade.\n\n**The money is in:**\n1. Waiting for retest (not breakout)\n2. Stacking filters (3+ signals)\n3. Reading price action (FVG, MSS, rejection)\n4. Following the rules 95%+ of the time\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udd0d FILTER DEFINITIONS (QUICK REFERENCE)\n\n| Filter | Definition | How to Check |\n|--------|-----------|-------------|\n| **VWAP** | Value-Weighted Average Price | Close > VWAP line = YES |\n| **EMA 20** | 20-period Exponential MA | Look at EMA 20 line |\n| **EMA 50** | 50-period Exponential MA | Look at EMA 50 line |\n| **EMA 200** | 200-period Exponential MA | Look at EMA 200 line |\n| **Volume** | 20-bar average volume | Current bar > 1.5x avg |\n| **Displacement** | Strong candle movement | Body > 2x average body |\n| **FVG** | Fair Value Gap (imbalance) | Gap left on breakout |\n| **MSS** | Market Structure Shift | Higher highs after sweep |\n| **Confluence** | Multiple signals aligned | Count how many filters YES |\n\n---\n\n## \ud83d\udda8\ufe0f INSTRUCTIONS FOR PRINTING\n\n1. Print this document (3-4 pages)\n2. Keep at your trading station\n3. Check this before EVERY entry\n4. Mark YES/NO as you go\n5. Review after each trade\n6. Update based on what you learn\n\n**Laminate it** if possible\u2014use it for multiple trading days.\n\n---\n\n**Print Date**: __________ \n**Trader**: __________ \n**Account**: __________\n\nUse this framework every single day.
